title: A lesson says what kind of gap it shows, where it goes, and who must confirm it
request: The owner: do the rest of the plan non-stop; the survey of phase 9 found 31.5 without its Lesson v1 and gap type.
spec: PHASE9_LEARNING_LOOP_PLAN.md Part F: the reflector writes one structured lesson (Lesson v1) with a gap type (knowledge, reasoning, decision, rule, capability, data) that decides where it goes; a person confirms rule and capability gaps, because those lead to code.
plan: Read the gap table and how the reflector maps codes to steps
Lesson v1 and the route in dclab_core
The rules' proposal from a grader code
The draft step writes lessons; a backfill for past drafts

decisions.decision: The rules propose the gap from the grader's code, labelled rule:gaps_v1
decisions.why: the codes already say which decision went wrong; a model or a person may propose otherwise, and the record says who

decisions.decision: Observed, expected and the lesson in the grader's and the rules' fixed words
decisions.why: a lesson never names a column, so it cannot carry a key's answer to another pack

decisions.decision: The link to the loop record runs through the lesson's evidence, not a new field
decisions.why: loop_record v1 was pushed tonight and may not change shape under its version; the evidence's pack and trace already find the attempt

decisions.decision: The backfill is a flag, not run on the owner's records
decisions.why: the owner cancelled code-written backfills on 2026-10-28; these are fixed rule texts, not reasoning, but the owner decides

decisions.decision: An attempt DCLab's rules made shows rule gaps, not decision gaps
decisions.why: nothing chose or reasoned in a rules solve; a missed trap is a check that did not stop it, which leads to code and so waits for a person

change: dclab_core/lesson.py (Lesson v1, ROUTE, RULES, propose; dclab-core 0.139.0, its schemas, the conformance entry); dclab_rnd/learning/reflect.py (lessons_for); drafting.py (keep_lessons, backfill_lessons, the draft step writes lessons); the loop-records command's --backfill-lessons; tests/test_lessons.py.

findings.defect: A new optional field changed loop_record v1's shape
findings.scenario: Adding Reflection.lessons and regenerating the schemas.
findings.cause: The contracts test refuses any change of shape under the same version, an optional field included.
findings.fix: The field was dropped; a lesson's evidence names its attempt instead.

findings.defect: Lessons were written for attempts that delivered nothing
findings.scenario: A solve crashes, observe() sees nothing kept out and no group, and the grader fires every trap code.
findings.cause: The draft step wrote lessons from the codes even when the reflector had refused the attempt (no holdout).
findings.fix: No lesson when the reflector found no step; the backfill skips such notes too.

findings.defect: The rules arm's misses were decision gaps that act with no one's yes
findings.scenario: Any draft attempt with a leak kept: the lesson went to a student's samples as a decision gap.
findings.cause: The mapping assumed a model made the attempt; the draft step's attempts are DCLab's rules.
findings.fix: propose takes the producer: a rules attempt's misses are rule gaps, confirmed by a person; the split's miss is split.strategy.

findings.defect: Every lesson cited grader_v1 whatever graded it
findings.scenario: Once the grader moves to v2, new lessons would still cite v1.
findings.cause: The version was written as text in lessons_for.
findings.fix: The draft step passes challenge_pack.GRADER and keeps it in its note; old notes say grader_v1, which graded them all.

findings.defect: An unsolvable variant got a capability lesson whose text was false
findings.scenario: The reference arm fails too, and the lesson says a reference solves the variant.
findings.cause: lessons_for never read whether the variant was solvable.
findings.fix: On an unsolvable variant the gap is the data's: nothing to act on.

outcome: Every grader code has the rules' proposed gap and decision point; a rules attempt's misses are rule gaps a person confirms; an attempt that delivered nothing teaches nothing; an unsolvable variant is a data gap.
lessons: Decide a new contract's fields before pushing it: under a frozen version even an optional field is a new version.
risks: The mapping is the rules' judgement and no model proposes a gap yet; a person's confirmations will show where it is wrong.
